description: Verified cross-chain anchor pair across the two live LTP legs. The SAME entity (entityIdHash) is anchored under the SAME registered bridge-operator signer (signerVkHash) with the SAME merkleRoot on both chains; each registry independently self-stamps its own targetChainId from block.chainid (the contract's cross-chain replay guard). Registry-level demonstration: on-chain anchor() authorizes by registered signerVkHash and does not verify the ML-DSA signature (off-chain concern), so no bridge-operator secret key was required.

funding.note: Base Sepolia gas obtained by depositing Ethereum Sepolia ETH through Base's canonical L1 bridge (L1->L2 deposit; Base Sepolia settles to Ethereum Sepolia).
